collection_notes: Ballot spelling 'Diane S Sykes'. Search results for 'Diane Sykes' are dominated by the unrelated federal Seventh Circuit judge Diane S. Sykes; those were excluded. Incumbency left null: Position 2 is an open seat per WW (only Adrian Brown, a different race, was an incumbent facing a challenger) but no official source states it; inventory had false. Judicial candidate: bio/qualifications only; no issue positions sought. Voters' pamphlet: Book 13 lists 4th District judges on pp. 59-61, but the PDF text is cut off by the fetch tool at ~120k characters (p. 49), so judicial statements could not be read; oregonvotes.gov military voters' guide pages surfaced by search for Sykes and Hagedorn redirect to the SOS elections home page (302), so they were not usable. Step 5 ran with allowed_domains limited to opb.org, wweek.com, portlandmercury.com because the proxy rejected longer domain lists. Bio items from WW's April 2026 endorsement piece are descriptive facts only; no endorsement content is used.
